text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: But it doesn't change the result. I was naive.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I didn't realize the race would be so… tough.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …I'm not sure. But I want to run again soon.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I won't settle for such a lackluster result next time in the Derby… I want first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian heads to the waiting room, tail swishing vivaciously behind her.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: …Hey, did you get a good picture of Narita Brian?

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: You bet I did! I got her right as she sped up!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: I feel a little sorry for the other racers in her year. Who would have thought that someone like her would show up?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I recall that conversation I overheard among the reporters the next day.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text: Hey, did you see the news about the last Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I saw it. The winner's a beast. We were aiming for the Derby too, but not anymore.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian's performance really was a shock to us all.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Did you see that article?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Do you mean the one called, "Inches From Derby Champion—the Astonishing Speed of Brian the Beast"?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Hey, did you see that one racer? She was a total beast on that final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: You mean Brian, right? I wonder if she'll be at the Derby too. I just messaged my trainer so we can talk about it.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Narita Brian…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's with all the commotion?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look over where Narita Brian is pointing to find a long line of people waiting to see her.
choice_data_list: This must be because of the news article…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch! Busybodies. …How annoying.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I don't have time for this right now. The next Classic Triple Crown race is coming up. I'm going to win the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone's expectations for Narita Brian are rising, but she is squarely focused on her next goal—the Japanese Derby.
